title: NOX METALS vs Alro Steel for Aluminum Plate: Instant Pricing vs the Branch Network
summary: Alro Steel runs 80-plus locations across 16 states with next-day delivery and heavy processing. NOX METALS gives you an instant price and a committed ship date without opening an account. An honest look at both.
body_markdown:
### Does Alro Steel show prices online?


Their main catalog directs you to a quote rather than displaying prices. Alro operates a separate online store for cut-to-size metals and plastics with next-day delivery. If you want a price without a quote request on aerospace aluminum plate, that is what our instant quote does.


### How many locations does Alro have?


Over 80 locations across 16 states, serving more than 50,000 customers. It is one of the larger metal service center networks in North America and a genuine advantage for local pickup and next-day regional delivery.


### Is Alro cheaper than NOX METALS?


It depends on volume and on your relationship. Service centers price by account, so a large established customer can do very well. Because their pricing is not published we cannot compare directly, which is itself part of the point: our price is visible before you commit.


### Can Alro supply DFARS compliant aluminum?


They do not publicly market DFARS or domestic-melt documentation, which is not the same as being unable to supply it. Ask for melt-source documentation in writing before you order. We stock DFARS-compliant and domestic-melt material across 6061, 7075 and 7050 as a standing offering.


### Who is better for waterjet or laser cutting?


Alro, without qualification. They run plate laser, high-definition plasma, oxy-fuel, and 5-axis waterjet. We cut rectangles on bandsaws. If your part needs a profile, they are the right supplier.
